- Note corrected: Lei 9.430: the note reads 'Redação dada pela nº 12.715, de 2012' (the word 'Lei' is missing).
- L9430: lines found alive before the law their note names: 0.
- Lines that close a quoted amendment ('....." (NR)', a quoted article, or a sentence ending with the closing quotation mark) are kept in the article that quotes them; the marginal-heading rule, which moves an unlabelled line without closing punctuation into the next article, does not apply to them (1 lines).
- Lei 9.430 art. 88 XXV ends '[...] o art. 89 da Lei nº 8.981, de 20 de janeiro de 1995, com a redação dada pela Lei nº 9.065, de 20 de junho de 1995;': these words name the wording of the article it revokes; they are part of the text, not an amendment note (l9430 art-88).
- Lei 9.430: Planalto's markers '(Sem eficácia)' after struck lines (wordings of Medidas Provisórias 252/2005, 303/2006 and 478/2009 that lapsed or never took effect, and the 1996 lines they touched) and 'Rejeitada' after the lines of Medida Provisória 75/2002 (rejected) are not part of the text and are left out (art-18, art-19-a, art-19-b, art-44, art-45, art-46, art-63, art-70).
- Lei 9.430: the headings above arts. 18 to 22 ('Seção V'; 'Preços de Transferência'; 'Bens, Serviços e Direitos Adquiridos no Exterior'; 'Receitas Oriundas de Exportações para o Exterior'; 'Apuração dos Preços Médios'; 'Juros'), struck with no note, fall with the articles under them, revoked by Lei 14.596/2023 from 1.1.2024 (its art. 46 VI), not with the first change of the article each heads.
- A period printed after an amendment note that follows a line already ending in ';', ':' or ',' ('... salário-maternidade; (Redação dada pela Lei nº 9.528, de 10.12.97).') closes the note and is dropped with it (lines: l9430 4).
- Lei 9.430 (open items): art. 87's 'efeitos financeiros a partir de 1º de janeiro de 1997' are financial effects only (the in-force day, 30.12.1996, is kept); changes whose effects reach back before their in-force day keep that day (Leis 9.959/2000, 10.637/2002 art. 49, 12.249/2010); Medida Provisória 2.158-35/2001 is dated by that edition; 'Vide' pointers (Medidas Provisórias 563/2012 on art. 22 and 1.152/2022 on arts. 18 to 24-B, Decreto 7.212/2010, Lei Complementar 214/2025 and others) strike no words and are not modelled.

[...] 70 a 75'), gave the paragraph its present wording: the 1996 wording stands until 1.1.2006; Planalto's second, struck copy of it (after the MP's lapse) is the same line; Lei 9.430 arts. 19-A and 19-B as Medida Provisória 478/2009 (DOU 29.12.2009, effects from 1.1.2010 for its arts. 9 and 10) added them: Planalto notes them only 'Vide Medida Provisória nº 478, de 2009'; they are the MP's wordings and stand from its day until it lapsed on 1.6.2010 (Ato Declaratório nº 18/2010); art. 19-A's later wording is Lei 12.715/2012's; Lei 9.430 art. 22: Lei 12.715/2012 art. 48 gave the caput a new wording and added § 5º, and its art. 79 I revoked § 4º, all from 1.1.2013 (art. 78 § 1º, art. 79 I); before that day Lei 12.766/2012 (DOU 28.12.2012) art. 5 gave the article its next wording with effects from 1.1.2013 and its art. 14 revoked § 5º. So Lei 12.715's caput and § 5º never took effect: the 1996 caput and § 4º stand until 1.1.2013, when Lei 12.766's wording applies; Lei 9.430 art. 63 § 3º: added by Medida Provisória 75/2002 (DOU 25.10.2002), which the Chamber rejected (in force to 18.12.2002); Planalto notes it only 'Vide Medida Provisória nº 75, de 2002', followed by 'Rejeitada'; Lei 9.430 arts. 45 and 46: Medida Provisória 303/2006 (in force 30.6.2006) revoked both; it lapsed on 27.10.2006 and they stood again from 28.10.2006 until Medida Provisória 351/2007 (22.1.2007) revoked them. - Acts of this part (Lei da Regularização Fundiária Rural e Urbana (Lei nº 13.465, de 11 de julho de 2017)): each paragraph's life span is read from Planalto's annotated page of the act (l13465.htm), with the replay of Lexifina's code (imported, not copied): struck wordings stay in place before the wording that replaced them, each closed by the source's own note ('Redação dada pela…', 'Incluído pela…', 'Revogado pela…'); text with no note is the act as enacted.
- Credits come only from those notes; a changed article with no note naming a law stays uncredited.
- A struck wording with no 'Revogado' note ends when the next wording of the same dispositivo (same label in the same article) starts; a Medida Provisória's wording with no later wording ends on the in-force day of the law that converted the MP (read from the MP page's 'Convertida na Lei' line).
- Medidas Provisórias are dated by publication (CF art. 62: force of law from publication); laws by their own vigência clause, else LINDB art. 1 (publication + 45 days).
- Lei da Regularização Fundiária Rural e Urbana (Lei nº 13.465, de 11 de julho de 2017): in force 2017-07-12 (Lei 13.465/2017 art. 108: 'Esta Lei entra em vigor na data de sua publicação' (DOU 12.7.2017, rectified 6.9.2017; the consolidated text republished in the DOU of 8.9.2017)).
- Headings (Parte, Livro, Título, Capítulo, Seção) and the marginal headings (rubricas) are kept in one file per act, titulos.md, one line each; a note standing alone after a heading is given to the heading lines just before it.
- Text normalised once: NBSP to space, runs of spaces collapsed, curly quotes and dashes made plain, 'Art. 1o' written 'Art. 1º'; Planalto's link words ('Vigência', 'Produção de efeitos') and 'Vide' notes are dropped.
- The consolidated pages print a revoked dispositivo as its bare label ('Art. 757.'); the check ignores those label-only lines, and the history leaves revoked text out.
- No OCR: every text comes from the HTML text layer of the Planalto pages.
- LREURB: lines found alive before the law their note names: 0.
- Lines that close a quoted amendment ('....." (NR)', a quoted article, or a sentence ending with the closing quotation mark) are kept in the article that quotes them; the marginal-heading rule, which moves an unlabelled line without closing punctuation into the next article, does not apply to them (16 lines).
- Lei 13.465: Planalto's link '(Partes vetadas)' after the parts promulgated on 8.9.2017 is not text and is left out; art. 4 quotes Lei 11.952 art. 16 ('Art. 16. As condições resolutivas [...]', §§ 1º to 3º) with no opening quotation mark, and those lines are read as lines of art. 4, not as Lei 13.465's own art. 16.
- Tables printed inside articles (l13465 2): Planalto centres their cells; each cell is a line of the article it is printed in (as in the CLT's art. 580), not a heading line.
- Lei 13.465 (open items): the text before 12.7.2017 (Medida Provisória 759/2016, of which this Lei is the conversion) is not part of the history; the rectification published on 6.9.2017 and the consolidated text republished on 8.9.2017 are read as Planalto prints the Lei (words as corrected); Planalto has no consolidated page for this Lei, so the check compares the annotated page's present text with itself.
- Life spans set by hand where Planalto's page cannot give them (Medidas Provisórias revoked, suspended by the STF or converted without the change): Lei 13.465: parts vetoed on 11.7.2017 and kept by Congress were promulgated by the President on 6.9.2017 ('Faço saber que o Congresso Nacional decreta e eu promulgo, nos termos do parágrafo 5º do art. 66 da Constituição Federal, as seguintes partes vetadas da Lei nº 13.465'; DOU 8.9.2017, printed at the foot of Planalto's page): in art. 3 the quoted new caput of Lei 13.001 art. 3 ('Ficam remitidos [...] R$ 10.000,00') and its closing line, art. 3-A (an article of Lei 13.465: caput and incisos I to IV) and in art. 4 the quoted Lei 11.952 art. 16 § 2º; they start on 8.9.2017, credited to Lei 13.465, and are absent before (the page prints no '(VETADO)' line for them); Lei 13.465 art. 33: Medida Provisória 996/2020 (26.8.2020) revoked the parágrafo único and added § 1º with the same incisos II and III; Lei 14.118/2021 (13.1.2021), its conversion, kept § 1º as the former parágrafo único (its art. 26 II: '§ 1º (antigo parágrafo único)'). Planalto prints II and III three times: struck with the 2017 parágrafo único, struck as the MP's, and unstruck with no note under Lei 14.118's § 1º: the last copy starts with Lei 14.118.

Medida Provisória nº 478, de 2009 (in force 2009-12-29) lapsed: Ato Declaratório do Presidente da Mesa do Congresso Nacional nº 18, de 2010 (DOU 15.6.2010): 'teve seu prazo de vigência encerrado no dia 1º de junho do corrente ano'; the wordings it had replaced are back from 2.6.2010; Medida Provisória nº 514, de 2010 (in force 2010-12-02) was converted into Lei nº 12.424, de 2011 (in force 2011-06-17); Medida Provisória nº 561, de 2012 (in force 2012-03-08) was converted into Lei nº 12.693, de 2012 (in force 2012-07-25); Medida Provisória nº 651, de 2014 (in force 2014-07-10) was converted into Lei nº 13.043, de 2014 (in force 2014-11-14); Medida Provisória nº 656, de 2014 (in force 2014-10-08) was converted into Lei nº 13.097, de 2015 (in force 2015-01-20); Medida Provisória nº 679, de 2015 (in force 2015-06-24) was converted into Lei nº 13.173, de 2015 (in force 2015-10-22); Medida Provisória nº 698, de 2015 (in force 2015-10-23) was converted into Lei nº 13.274, de 2016 (in force 2016-04-27); Medida Provisória nº 759, de 2016 (in force 2016-12-23) was converted into Lei nº 13.465, de 2017 (in force 2017-07-12); Medida Provisória nº 996, de 2020 (in force 2020-08-26) was converted into Lei nº 14.118, de 2021 (in force 2021-01-13).

(VETADO).'); Congress overrode the veto and the article was promulgated on 17.4.2018 (DOU 18.4.2018, printed on Lei 13.606's page, as for Lei 8.212 art. 25 § 12 in 99-batch15a). - Credits come only from those notes; a changed article with no note naming a law stays uncredited.

- Lines that close a quoted amendment ('....." (NR)', a quoted article, or a sentence ending with the closing quotation mark) are kept in the article that quotes them; the marginal-heading rule, which moves an unlabelled line without closing punctuation into the next article, does not apply to them (2 lines).
- Lei 12.462 art. 63 § 17 was added by Medida Provisória 1.349/2026 (DOU 7.4.2026); Planalto's page of the MP reads 'Vigência encerrada' and links Ato Declaratório nº 77 of 2026, which could not be read, so the day the paragraph lapsed is not known: it is LEFT OUT of every version (the consolidated page, not updated, still prints it).

- Life spans set by hand where Planalto's page cannot give them (Medidas Provisórias revoked, suspended by the STF or converted without the change): Lei 12.462 art. 63: Lei 14.034/2020 (DOU 6.8.2020) art. 13: 'produzirá efeitos, quanto ao § 5º do art. 63 da Lei nº 12.462 [...] alterado pelo art. 7º desta Lei, e quanto aos incisos II e III do caput do art. 12 desta Lei, em 1º de janeiro de 2021': its § 5º (caput and incisos I and II) and the revocation of § 1º II (art. 12 III) take effect on 1.1.2021; its other changes to art. 63 on 6.8.2020; Lei 12.462 art. 63-B (caput and parágrafo único), added by Lei 14.901/2024 art. 3 (DOU 26.6.2024, in force on publication): its art. 5 reads '[...] nos termos do art. 140 da Lei nº 14.791, de 29 de dezembro de 2023, o art. 63-B acrescido à Lei nº 12.462 [...] pelo art. 3º desta Lei terá vigência por 5 (cinco) anos'. The term runs from 26.6.2024, the first day counted, to 25.6.2029, so the article is in force to that day and leaves the text on 26.6.2029 (on the futuro branch while that day is ahead), credited to Lei 14.901. - Acts of this part (Lei de Improbidade Administrativa (Lei nº 8.429, de 2 de junho de 1992); Lei de Crimes Ambientais (Lei nº 9.605, de 12 de fevereiro de 1998); Lei de Acesso à Informação (Lei nº 12.527, de 18 de novembro de 2011); Lei do Processo Administrativo Federal (Lei nº 9.784, de 29 de janeiro de 1999)): each paragraph's life span is read from Planalto's annotated page of the act (l8429.htm, l9605.htm, l12527.htm, l9784.htm), with the replay of Lexifina's code (imported, not copied): struck wordings stay in place before the wording that replaced them, each closed by the source's own note ('Redação dada pela…', 'Incluído pela…', 'Revogado pela…'); text with no note is the act as enacted.
- Credits come only from those notes; a changed article with no note naming a law stays uncredited.
- A struck wording with no 'Revogado' note ends when the next wording of the same dispositivo (same label in the same article) starts; a Medida Provisória's wording with no later wording ends on the in-force day of the law that converted the MP (read from the MP page's 'Convertida na Lei' line).
- Medidas Provisórias are dated by publication (CF art. 62: force of law from publication); laws by their own vigência clause, else LINDB art. 1 (publication + 45 days).
- Lei de Improbidade Administrativa (Lei nº 8.429, de 2 de junho de 1992): in force 1992-06-03 (Lei 8.429/1992 art. 24: 'Esta lei entra em vigor na data de sua publicação' (DOU 3.6.1992)).
- Lei de Crimes Ambientais (Lei nº 9.605, de 12 de fevereiro de 1998): in force 1998-03-30 (Lei 9.605/1998: its vigência article (art. 81) was vetoed, so LINDB art. 1 applies: in force 45 days after publication (DOU 13.2.1998), on 30.3.1998. The DOU of 17.2.1998 printed a retificação, but it corrects only the heading ('onde se lê: Nº 9.605, DE FEVEREIRO DE 1998 leia-se: LEI Nº 9.605, DE 12 DE FEVEREIRO DE 1998', as the Chamber of Deputies' record of the law gives it), not the law's text, so it is not a new publication of the text that would restart the period (LINDB art. 1 § 3)).
- Lei de Acesso à Informação (Lei nº 12.527, de 18 de novembro de 2011): in force 2012-05-16 (Lei 12.527/2011 art. 47: 'Esta Lei entra em vigor 180 (cento e oitenta) dias após a data de sua publicação' (DOU 18.11.2011, edição extra): the 180th day counted from publication is 15.5.2012 (LC 95/1998 art. 8 § 1)).
- Lei do Processo Administrativo Federal (Lei nº 9.784, de 29 de janeiro de 1999): in force 1999-02-01 (Lei 9.784/1999 art. 70: 'Esta Lei entra em vigor na data de sua publicação' (DOU 1.2.1999). The retificação in the DOU of 11.3.1999 corrects only the signatures ('Na página 5, 1ª coluna, nas assinaturas, leia-se: Fernando Henrique Cardoso, Renan Calheiros e Paulo Paiva', as the Chamber of Deputies' record of the law gives it), not the law's text).
- Headings (Parte, Livro, Título, Capítulo, Seção) and the marginal headings (rubricas) are kept in one file per act, titulos.md, one line each; a note standing alone after a heading is given to the heading lines just before it.
- Text normalised once: NBSP to space, runs of spaces collapsed, curly quotes and dashes made plain, 'Art. 1o' written 'Art. 1º'; Planalto's link words ('Vigência', 'Produção de efeitos') and 'Vide' notes are dropped.
- The consolidated pages print a revoked dispositivo as its bare label ('Art. 757.'); the check ignores those label-only lines, and the history leaves revoked text out.
- No OCR: every text comes from the HTML text layer of the Planalto pages.
- Some laws are in force on one day but defer the effects of some provisions ('produzirá efeitos'); a change is dated by the day it takes effect where the clause fixes a later day for it (the effect-days decision lists the units moved); effects that are retroactive, financial only or left to a later act or condition keep the in-force day. Their clauses: Lei Complementar nº 157, de 2016 (in force 2016-12-30): "Esta Lei Complementar entra em vigor na data de sua publicação. § 1º O disposto no caput e nos §§ 1º e 2º do art. 8 o -A da Lei Complementar n o 116, de 31 de julho de 2003, e no art. 10-A, no inciso IV do art. 12 e no § 13 do art. 17, todos da Lei n o 8.429, …"
- LIA: lines found alive before the law their note names: 0.
- LCA: lines found alive before the law their note names: 0.
- LAI: lines found alive before the law their note names: 0.
- LPA: lines found alive before the law their note names: 0.
- Lines that close a quoted amendment ('....." (NR)', a quoted article, or a sentence ending with the closing quotation mark) are kept in the article that quotes them; the marginal-heading rule, which moves an unlabelled line without closing punctuation into the next article, does not apply to them (4 lines).
- Medida Provisória pages whose heading leaves out 'DE' before the year ('MEDIDA PROVISÓRIA Nº 62, DE 22 DE AGOSTO 2002') are read with it, for their dates only: Medida Provisória nº 2.163, de 2001, Medida Provisória nº 62, de 2002.
- A dispositivo noted '(Incluído pela Lei X, com a redação dada pela Lei Y)' is credited to Y, the law that wrote its words, from the later of the two laws' in-force days: lei-de-improbidade-administrativa art-10 [XIX -] (Lei nº 13.019, de 2014, wording Lei nº 13.204, de 2015, from 2016-01-23); lei-de-improbidade-administrativa art-10 [XX -] (Lei nº 13.019, de 2014, wording Lei nº 13.204, de 2015, from 2016-01-23).
- Notes whose verb has a typing slip are read with the verb corrected, so the note is not taken for law text: '(Renumerando do ...)' is read as '(Renumerado do ...)' (Lei 9.605 art. 25 §§ 3º to 5º, renumbered by Lei 13.052/2014).
- A dispositivo Planalto prints only under its new number, with a 'Renumerado do ... para ...' note, stood under its old number with the same words until the renumbering; that wording is added: lei-de-crimes-ambientais art-25 [§ 4º -> § 5º]; lei-de-crimes-ambientais art-25 [§ 3º -> § 4º].
- A wording a lapsed Medida Provisória had replaced is back from the lapse until the law that renumbered it: lei-de-crimes-ambientais art-25 [§ 2º] 2002-11-20..2014-12-09.
- A wording Planalto credits to both the first and the last Medida Provisória of one reissue chain starts with the first, once its text is found on both MP pages (the reissues kept it in force): lei-de-improbidade-administrativa art-17 [§ 3º] from Medida Provisória nº 1.337, de 1996 (also printed in Medida Provisória nº 1.472, de 1996); lei-de-improbidade-administrativa art-17 [§ 5º] from Medida Provisória nº 1.984, de 2000 (also printed in Medida Provisória nº 2.180, de 2001).
- Struck wordings that never took effect are left out of every version: Lei 8.429 art. 10 XIX to XXI as Lei 13.019/2014 art. 77 first inserted them (struck, noted only 'Incluído pela Lei nº 13.019, de 2014'): Lei 13.204/2015 (DOU 15.12.2015, in force on publication) rewrote that art. 77 before Lei 13.019 came into force on 23.1.2016, so art. 10 received the wording of XIX and XX that Planalto notes 'Incluído pela Lei nº 13.019, de 2014, com a redação dada pela Lei nº 13.204, de 2015', and XXI never existed (lei-de-improbidade-administrativa art-10 [XIX -] 'XIX - frustrar a licitude de processo seletivo para celebraç'; lei-de-improbidade-administrativa art-10 [XX -] 'XX - agir negligentemente na celebração, fiscalização e anál'; lei-de-improbidade-administrativa art-10 [XXI -] 'XXI - liberar recursos de parcerias firmadas pela administra').
- Medidas Provisórias and their fate, from each MP page's 'Convertida na Lei' line or the Congress records: Medida Provisória nº 1.337, de 1996 (in force 1996-03-13) stands: Medida Provisória nº 1.337, de 12.3.1996 (DOU 13.3.1996), 'Reeditada pela MPV nº 1.379, de 1996', a chain of reissues with the same ementa down to MP 1.472-31, de 22.11.1996, 'Convertida na Lei nº 9.366, de 1996'; Planalto credits the wording of Lei 8.429 art. 17 § 3º to both MP 1.337 and MP 1.472-31 and the next wording to Lei 9.366, which ends it; Medida Provisória nº 1.472, de 1996 (in force 1996-11-23) was converted into Lei nº 9.366, de 1996 (in force 1996-12-18); Medida Provisória nº 1.710, de 1998 (in force 1998-08-10) stands: Medida Provisória nº 1.710, de 7.8.1998, 'Reeditada pela MPv nº 1.710-1, de 1998', whose changed wording of Lei 9.605 art. 79-A Planalto prints and credits separately: the reissue's wording ends it; Medida Provisória nº 1.710-1, de 1998 (in force 1998-09-09) stands: Medida Provisória nº 1.710-1, de 8.9.1998, 'Reeditada pela MPv nº 1.710-2, de 1998', a chain of reissues down to MP 2.163-41, de 23.8.2001; Planalto prints no wording of the reissues in between, so its wording of Lei 9.605 art. 79-A stands until MP 2.163-41's; Medida Provisória nº 1.984, de 2000 (in force 2000-04-07) stands: Medida Provisória nº 1.984-16, de 6.4.2000 (DOU 7.4.2000), 'Reeditada pela MPv nº 1.984-17', a chain of reissues with the same ementa down to MP 2.180-35, de 24.8.2001; Planalto credits Lei 8.429 art. 17 § 5º to both; Medida Provisória nº 2.163, de 2001 (in force 2001-08-24) stands: Medida Provisória nº 2.163-41, de 23.8.2001 (DOU 24.8.2001) was in force on 11.9.2001, so it stays in force until a later MP revokes it or Congress votes on it (Emenda Constitucional 32/2001, art. 2); Medida Provisória nº 2.180, de 2001 (in force 2001-08-27) stands: Medida Provisória nº 2.180-35, de 24.8.2001 (DOU 27.8.2001) was in force on 11.9.2001, so it stays in force until a later MP revokes it or Congress votes on it (Emenda Constitucional 32/2001, art. 2); Medida Provisória nº 62, de 2002 (in force 2002-08-23) lapsed: declared 'prejudicada': Ato Declaratório do Presidente do Senado Federal de 20.11.2002 (DOU 21.11.2002): 'em sessão realizada no dia 20 de novembro de 2002, o Plenário da Casa declarou prejudicada a Medida Provisória nº 62, de 22 de agosto de 2002 [...] em virtude da rejeição do Projeto de Lei de Conversão nº 27, de 2002'; the Lei 9.605 wording of art. 25 it had replaced is back from that day; Medida Provisória nº 703, de 2015 (in force 2015-12-21) lapsed: Ato Declaratório do Presidente da Mesa do Congresso Nacional nº 27, de 2016 (DOU 31.5.2016): the MP, 'publicada no Diário Oficial da União no dia 21' of December 2015, 'teve seu prazo de vigência encerrado no dia 29 de maio'; the Lei 12.846 wording it had replaced or revoked is back from 30.5.2016.

- Credits come only from those notes; a changed article with no note naming a law stays uncredited.
- A struck wording with no 'Revogado' note ends when the next wording of the same dispositivo (same label in the same article) starts; a Medida Provisória's wording with no later wording ends on the in-force day of the law that converted the MP (read from the MP page's 'Convertida na Lei' line).
- Medidas Provisórias are dated by publication (CF art. 62: force of law from publication); laws by their own vigência clause, else LINDB art. 1 (publication + 45 days).

The retificação in the DOU of 17.7.2001 corrects only the signatures ('Na página 5, 1ª coluna, nas assinaturas, leia-se: ...', as the Chamber of Deputies' record of the law gives it), so it does not restart the period (LINDB art. 1 § 3)).
- Estatuto da Pessoa Idosa (Lei nº 10.741, de 1º de outubro de 2003): in force 2004-01-01 (Lei 10.741/2003 art. 118: 'Esta Lei entra em vigor decorridos 90 (noventa) dias da sua publicação, ressalvado o disposto no caput do art. 36, que vigorará a partir de 1º de janeiro de 2004' (DOU 3.10.2003): the 90th day counted from publication is 31.12.2003 (LC 95/1998 art. 8 § 1), so the whole law, art. 36 included, is in force from 1.1.2004).
- Lei de Execução Penal (Lei nº 7.210, de 11 de julho de 1984): in force 1985-01-13 (Lei 7.210/1984 art. 204: 'Esta Lei entra em vigor concomitantemente com a lei de reforma da Parte Geral do Código Penal', Lei 7.209/1984 (DOU 13.7.1984), whose art. 5 puts it in force six months after publication, on 13.1.1985 (as in this corpus' Código Penal)).
- Lei das Sociedades por Ações (Lei nº 6.404, de 15 de dezembro de 1976): in force 1977-02-15 (Lei 6.404/1976 art. 300: 'A presente Lei entrará em vigor 60 (sessenta) dias após a sua publicação, aplicando-se, todavia, a partir da data da publicação, às companhias que se constituírem' (DOU 17.12.1976): in force 60 days after publication, on 15.2.1977; for companies formed from 17.12.1976 it applied from publication).
- Marco Legal das Startups (Lei Complementar nº 182, de 1º de junho de 2021): in force 2021-08-31 (Lei Complementar 182/2021 art. 18: 'Esta Lei Complementar entra em vigor após decorridos 90 (noventa) dias de sua publicação oficial' (DOU 2.6.2021): the 90th day counted from publication is 30.8.2021 (LC 95/1998 art. 8 § 1). (NR)', a quoted article, or a sentence ending with the closing quotation mark) are kept in the article that quotes them; the marginal-heading rule, which moves an unlabelled line without closing punctuation into the next article, does not apply to them (20 lines).
- Twin wordings: a line printed below a struck line of the same dispositivo with the same start, word for word the same or (with no note of its own) a new wording, starts on the first day from the struck line's end on when no other wording of that dispositivo stands, or with the restored caput of its article; a struck lower copy that never stands alone is left out: lei-de-responsabilidade-fiscal art-21 [I -] from 2020-05-28.

- Acts of this part (Estatuto do Desarmamento (Lei nº 10.826, de 22 de dezembro de 2003); Lei de Lavagem de Dinheiro (Lei nº 9.613, de 3 de março de 1998); Lei dos Crimes Hediondos (Lei nº 8.072, de 25 de julho de 1990); Lei de Introdução às Normas do Direito Brasileiro (Decreto-Lei nº 4.657, de 4 de setembro de 1942); Lei das Organizações Criminosas (Lei nº 12.850, de 2 de agosto de 2013); Lei da Propriedade Industrial (Lei nº 9.279, de 14 de maio de 1996); Lei de Direitos Autorais (Lei nº 9.610, de 19 de fevereiro de 1998); Estatuto da Juventude (Lei nº 12.852, de 5 de agosto de 2013); Lei Geral do Turismo (Lei nº 11.771, de 17 de setembro de 2008); Estatuto da Pessoa com Deficiência (Lei nº 13.146, de 6 de julho de 2015)): each paragraph's life span is read from Planalto's annotated page of the act (l10.826.htm, l9613.htm, l8072.htm, del4657.htm, l12850.htm, l9279.htm, l9610.htm, l12852.htm, l11771.htm, l13146.htm), with the replay of Lexifina's code (imported, not copied): struck wordings stay in place before the wording that replaced them, each closed by the source's own note ('Redação dada pela…', 'Incluído pela…', 'Revogado pela…'); text with no note is the act as enacted.
- Credits come only from those notes; a changed article with no note naming a law stays uncredited.
- A struck wording with no 'Revogado' note ends when the next wording of the same dispositivo (same label in the same article) starts; a Medida Provisória's wording with no later wording ends on the in-force day of the law that converted the MP (read from the MP page's 'Convertida na Lei' line).
- Medidas Provisórias are dated by publication (CF art. 62: force of law from publication); laws by their own vigência clause, else LINDB art. 1 (publication + 45 days).
- Estatuto do Desarmamento (Lei nº 10.826, de 22 de dezembro de 2003): in force 2003-12-23 (Lei 10.826/2003 art. 37: 'Esta Lei entra em vigor na data de sua publicação' (DOU 23.12.2003)).
- Lei de Lavagem de Dinheiro (Lei nº 9.613, de 3 de março de 1998): in force 1998-03-04 (Lei 9.613/1998 art. 18: 'Esta Lei entra em vigor na data de sua publicação' (DOU 4.3.1998)).
- Lei dos Crimes Hediondos (Lei nº 8.072, de 25 de julho de 1990): in force 1990-07-26 (Lei 8.072/1990 art. 12: 'Esta lei entra em vigor na data de sua publicação' (DOU 26.7.1990)).
- Lei de Introdução às Normas do Direito Brasileiro (Decreto-Lei nº 4.657, de 4 de setembro de 1942): in force 1942-10-24 (Decreto-Lei 4.657/1942 has no vigência clause of its own, so its own art. 1 applies: 'a lei começa a vigorar em todo o país quarenta e cinco dias depois de oficialmente publicada' (DOU 9.9.1942): in force on 24.10.1942. The DOU of 8.10.1942 and of 17.6.1943 printed retificações; the history starts from the text as Planalto prints it, dated 24.10.1942).

- Acts of this part (Lei da Ação Civil Pública (Lei nº 7.347, de 24 de julho de 1985); Código de Trânsito Brasileiro (Lei nº 9.503, de 23 de setembro de 1997); Lei de Diretrizes e Bases da Educação Nacional (Lei nº 9.394, de 20 de dezembro de 1996); Lei Orgânica da Saúde (Lei nº 8.080, de 19 de setembro de 1990); Lei das Eleições (Lei nº 9.504, de 30 de setembro de 1997); Código Florestal (Lei nº 12.651, de 25 de maio de 2012); Lei de Registros Públicos (Lei nº 6.015, de 31 de dezembro de 1973); Lei de Licitações e Contratos (Lei nº 8.666, de 21 de junho de 1993)): each paragraph's life span is read from Planalto's annotated page of the act (l7347orig.htm, l9503.htm, l9394.htm, l8080.htm, l9504.htm, l12651.htm, l6015consolidado.htm, l8666cons.htm), with the replay of Lexifina's code (imported, not copied): struck wordings stay in place before the wording that replaced them, each closed by the source's own note ('Redação dada pela…', 'Incluído pela…', 'Revogado pela…'); text with no note is the act as enacted.
- Credits come only from those notes; a changed article with no note naming a law stays uncredited.
- A struck wording with no 'Revogado' note ends when the next wording of the same dispositivo (same label in the same article) starts; a Medida Provisória's wording with no later wording ends on the in-force day of the law that converted the MP (read from the MP page's 'Convertida na Lei' line).
- Medidas Provisórias are dated by publication (CF art. 62: force of law from publication); laws by their own vigência clause, else LINDB art. 1 (publication + 45 days).
- Lei da Ação Civil Pública (Lei nº 7.347, de 24 de julho de 1985): in force 1985-07-25 (Lei 7.347/1985 art. 21 (renumbered art. 22 by Lei 8.078/1990): 'Esta lei entra em vigor na data de sua publicação' (DOU 25.7.1985)).
- Código de Trânsito Brasileiro (Lei nº 9.503, de 23 de setembro de 1997): in force 1998-01-22 (Lei 9.503/1997 art. 340: 'Este Código entra em vigor cento e vinte dias após a data de sua publicação' (DOU 24.9.1997): 22.1.1998).
- Lei de Diretrizes e Bases da Educação Nacional (Lei nº 9.394, de 20 de dezembro de 1996): in force 1996-12-23 (Lei 9.394/1996 art. 91: 'Esta Lei entra em vigor na data de sua publicação' (DOU 23.12.1996)).
- Lei Orgânica da Saúde (Lei nº 8.080, de 19 de setembro de 1990): in force 1990-09-20 (Lei 8.080/1990 art. 54: 'Esta lei entra em vigor na data de sua publicação' (DOU 20.9.1990)).
- Lei das Eleições (Lei nº 9.504, de 30 de setembro de 1997): in force 1997-10-01 (Lei 9.504/1997 art. 106: 'Esta Lei entra em vigor na data de sua publicação' (DOU 1.10.1997)).
- Código Florestal (Lei nº 12.651, de 25 de maio de 2012): in force 2012-05-28 (Lei 12.651/2012 art. 84: 'Esta Lei entra em vigor na data de sua publicação' (DOU 28.5.2012)).
- Lei de Registros Públicos (Lei nº 6.015, de 31 de dezembro de 1973): in force 1976-01-01 (Lei 6.015/1973 art. 310 as enacted put it in force on 1.7.1974; Lei 6.064/1974 moved that to 1.7.1975 ('Redação dada pela Lei nº 6.064, de 1974'), and Lei 6.216/1975, published in the DOU of 1.7.1975, rewrote the article (renumbered art. 295, later art. 298): 'Esta Lei entrará em vigor no dia 1º de janeiro 1976'. The act was never in force before 1.1.1976; Lei 6.216 art. 2 had it republished with its changes (DOU 16.9.1975), the text Planalto's page follows ('Atualizada a partir da republicação')).
- Lei de Licitações e Contratos (Lei nº 8.666, de 21 de junho de 1993): in force 1993-06-22 (Lei 8.666/1993 art. 125 (art. 124 before Lei 8.883/1994 renumbered it): 'Esta Lei entra em vigor na data de sua publicação' (DOU 22.6.1993)).
- Headings (Parte, Livro, Título, Capítulo, Seção) and the marginal headings (rubricas) are kept in one file per act, titulos.md, one line each; a note standing alone after a heading is given to the heading lines just before it.
- Text normalised once: NBSP to space, runs of spaces collapsed, curly quotes and dashes made plain, 'Art. 1o' written 'Art. 1º'; Planalto's link words ('Vigência', 'Produção de efeitos') and 'Vide' notes are dropped.
- The consolidated pages print a revoked dispositivo as its bare label ('Art. 757.'); the check ignores those label-only lines, and the history leaves revoked text out.
- No OCR: every text comes from the HTML text layer of the Planalto pages.
- Laws in force before the act itself: their changes are a second version of the act's first day ('same_day'), after the act as enacted: Lei nº 6.064, de 1974 (in force 1974-06-28) in the lei-de-registros-publicos; Lei nº 6.140, de 1974 (in force 1975-07-01) in the lei-de-registros-publicos; Lei nº 6.216, de 1975 (in force 1975-07-01) in the lei-de-registros-publicos.

- Text corrections (a note read into its line; misprinted words corrected from the amending law): Código Florestal art. 74: the words '(redação dada pela Medida Provisória nº 2.216-37, de 31 de agosto de 2001, é autorizada a adotar medidas [...])' are the article's own text ('... da Lei nº 9.649, de 27 de maio de 1998, com a redação dada pela Medida Provisória nº 2.216-37 [...], é autorizada a adotar ...'); the page sets them in a way the parser read as a note, so they are put back into the line; Lei de Registros Públicos art. 195-A § 7º: the annotated page prints, under the note 'Incluído pela Lei nº 13.465, de 2017', 'as terras devolutas a ele transferidas em razão de legislação'; Lei 13.465/2017's own text (and the unstruck text of Planalto's page of the act (Planalto publishes no separate consolidated page for it), and the wording of Medida Provisória nº 759/2016 it converted) reads 'as terras devolutas transferidas ao Município em razão de legislação', which the history uses.
- Lei 8.666/1993 was repealed as a whole by Lei 14.133/2021 art. 193 II, in the wording Lei Complementar 198/2023 gave it ('Revogam-se: [...] II - em 30 de dezembro de 2023: a) a Lei nº 8.666, de 21 de junho de 1993'; the first wording set two years from 1.4.2021, Medida Provisória 1.167/2023 and then LC 198/2023 moved it), so its last version, on 30.12.2023, removes every provision, credited to Lei 14.133/2021. Its arts. 89 to 108 had been revoked on 1.4.2021 (art. 193 I). After the repeal Planalto strikes the whole page, so the page is read from a capture of 20.11.2023, before the repeal, and the history up to 29.12.2023 is checked against that capture's unstruck text.
- L8666: the last version before the repeal (2022-06-15) differs from the unstruck text of the pre-repeal capture of Planalto's page in 0 articles.
- Lei de Registros Públicos: the act as enacted (DOU 31.12.1973) never took effect: its start was moved from 1.7.1974 to 1.7.1975 (Lei 6.064/1974) and then to 1.1.1976 (Lei 6.216/1975, published 1.7.1975), and Lei 6.216 art. 2 had the act republished with its changes (DOU 16.9.1975, Suplemento). Its first version is the text in force on 1.1.1976, as republished, credited to Lei 6.015/1973 and noted as including the changes of Leis 6.064/1974, 6.140/1974 and 6.216/1975 (Planalto's page prints those changes over the 1973 text); there is no version of the 1973 text.

(no '§'); the consolidated page prints '§ 3º'; Código de Trânsito art. 231 VI is printed with a stray apostrophe before the numeral; the consolidated page has none; Lei Orgânica da Saúde: 'Art. 6º A.' - Life spans set by hand where Planalto's page cannot give them (Medidas Provisórias revoked, suspended by the STF or converted without the change): Lei da Ação Civil Pública art. 1: Lei 10.257/2001 (Estatuto da Cidade, DOU 11.7.2001, in force 9.10.2001) art. 53 would have added 'III - à ordem urbanística' and renumbered III-V as IV-VI, but Medida Provisória nº 2.180-35/2001 (DOU 27.8.2001; in force on 11.9.2001, so it stays in force under Emenda Constitucional 32/2001 art. 2) revoked that art. 53 before it took effect (Lei 10.257's page: '(Revogado pela Medida Provisória nº 2.180-35, de 24.8.2001)'), and itself added 'VI - à ordem urbanística', reworded V and added the Parágrafo único. The lines Planalto prints for Lei 10.257's numbering never stood and are left out; incisos III and IV keep their wording throughout (Planalto prints them twice); Código de Trânsito art. 282-A: Planalto prints a bare label line '§ 5º (Vide Lei nº 14.440, de 2022) (Vigência)' where Lei 14.440/2022 adds a § 5º from 1.1.2027 (its art. 7 I, with the new caput); the label line is left out, and Lei 14.440's 2027 wording of art. 282-A caput and § 5º, which Planalto's page does not print, is not in the history; Código de Trânsito art. 312-A IV in Lei 13.281/2016's wording is printed unstruck above the wording 'Redação dada pela Lei nº 14.599, de 2023' that replaced it; it ends with that law (as II and III above it); LDB art. 36-B: Lei 14.645/2023 (in force 3.8.2023) renumbered the Parágrafo único as § 1º and added §§ 2º and 3º; Planalto prints the struck Parágrafo único with its incisos I to III and then the § 1º with the same incisos, unstruck and with Lei 11.741/2008's note, so these start with the renumbering, when the struck copies end; Código Florestal art. 3 VIII b): STF, ADC 42, ADI 4.903 and ADI 4.937 (Plenário, judgment concluded 28.2.2018, Informativo STF 892) declared unconstitutional the expressions 'gestão de resíduos' and 'instalações necessárias à realização de competições esportivas estaduais, nacionais ou internacionais'; Planalto strikes them inside the line. The history drops them from 28.2.2018, the judgment day (the DJe day of the session's ata is not in the records read), credited to the ruling; Lei de Registros Públicos art. 167 I items 28 and 37: Lei 10.257/2001 (enacted 10.7.2001, in force 9.10.2001) arts. 55 and 56 gave item 28 and added item 37 with the words 'independente da regularidade do parcelamento do solo ou da edificação'; Medida Provisória nº 2.220/2001 (DOU 5.9.2001, edição extra, in force on publication; kept in force by Emenda Constitucional 32/2001 art. 2), the later act, gave both items their wording without those words, which Planalto prints as today's. Lei 10.257's wordings never stood and are left out; Lei de Registros Públicos art. 288-A § 2º: Planalto prints the paragraph twice, once with Medida Provisória nº 514/2010's wording and again, word for word, inside the article as its conversion law Lei 12.424/2011 worded it, with the MP's note; the second copy starts with the conversion law, when the first ends; Lei 8.666 art. 21 § 2º V as enacted ('V - 5 (cinco) dias úteis para o convite.') is printed struck with no note; Lei 8.883/1994 recast § 2º into incisos I to IV, the convite's period becoming inciso IV ('IV - cinco dias úteis para convite.'), so it ends with that law (in force 9.6.1994).

## What AI did and did not do

The scripts that read the sources and build this repository were written by Claude Code running Claude Opus 5.5 (`claude-opus-5-5`) under Lexifina's direction.

No model wrote, translated or corrected legal text. No model runs at build time. Every word of law in this repository comes from the official sources above.

The commit messages are written by `build.py` from the source data.

Model use at data-build time:
- none: no model wrote, translated or summarised legal text; the parser and the hand tables (vigência overrides, heading renames, court ruling) were written by an AI coding agent from the official pages, and each hand entry is checked against those pages when the text is parsed.
